tools.name: search_guides_for_georgians_in_us
tools.description: Use for any everyday-life question from a Georgian speaker in the US, especially New York (ქართველები ამერიკაში, ნიუ-იორკი): where to buy E-ZPass and paying tolls, renting an apartment, cosigners, subway and bus fares and OMNY, scams aimed at Uber and Lyft drivers, salvage-title cars, Zelle pay and taxes, driving on a Georgian license, loan-offer scams, sending or exchanging money with Georgia, remote jobs, and English words. Accepts English or Georgian. Returns up to 5 kartvelians.com guides with summary and link.

lang.description: Answer language: "en" or "ka" (Georgian). Defaults to the query language.

tools.name: get_guide_for_georgians_in_us
tools.description: Get the summary, key facts, risk level and link for one kartvelians.com guide by slug (from search_guides_for_georgians_in_us or list_guides_for_georgians_in_us).

lang.description: Answer language: "en" or "ka" (Georgian). Defaults to the query language.

tools.name: list_guides_for_georgians_in_us
tools.description: List the kartvelians.com guides for Georgian speakers in the US, and planned topics marked "coming soon".

lang.description: Answer language: "en" or "ka" (Georgian). Defaults to the query language.
